Fleeing, you wander into a deserted zoo. But\n
no cheering crowds are left. A looming shadow\n
shakes the earth: ruin is right behind you.\n
Countless killers surround the police station,\n
closing in to crush the enforcers of justice.\n
Forward or back? Life or death rides on it.\n
Tense silence smothers the subway platform.\n
Eyes crawl through the dark, sealing every exit.\n
They don't flinch. Mercilessly they choose prey.\n
Deep in misty woods, a mad house of raw hatred.\n
Blood, poison, love, hate: the chilling truth\n
hides in the scars. Shake off the evil. Escape!\n
A merciless countdown ticks toward total ruin.\n
A heartless tyrant's claws rend a city of chaos.\n
Rise now: hope rests in your hands.\n
Explore the map and wipe out every enemy!\n
Quick thinking and sharp controls are a must!\n
Defeat the bosses that attack one after another!\n
Carrying items over is the key to success!\n
Welcome to Raccoon City, city of the dead.\n
Master the basics, and prepare to survive.\n
